Custom Kitchens provides luxury kitchen and bath renovations with over 65 years of experience!

  
We believe you deserve the finest in design, installation, and service for your kitchen and bath renovation.

Custom Kitchens, Inc. provides kitchen and bath renovations with a focus on the details. We listen to our clients’ needs and do everything we can to make the renovation process a pleasure. 

For over 65 years, it’s been a promise from our family to yours.

CLIENT HAPPINESS IS WHAT DRIVES US:
“
The installers were absolute craftsmen and took pride in everything they did, as if they were going to live here themselves. Every employee on the Custom Kitchens team was nice, friendly, very respectful of our home and dedicated to the project. We were truly amazed at the pride, craftsmanship, and commitment shown by the team every day, and to every detail.
— Kitchen Renovation, Near West End
READ MORE TESTIMONIALS

Our team is here to make your renovation dreams come true.

Our team of licensed contractors, certified kitchen and bath designers, and experienced craftsmen will help you create the perfect kitchen or bath that meets your needs and budget.

MEET THE TEAM

Our showroom is here to help you find the perfect style for your kitchen or bath renovation.

Our award-winning showroom is open to the public five days a week with a certified designer always on site to help you get inspired and start planning your dream renovation.

VISIT US
Our kitchen and bath renovations showcase all types of design styles, layouts, and functional needs.

Our promise is to create the kitchen or bath renovation of your dreams. Our portfolio features some our favorite projects we’ve had the pleasure of working on as well as some of our most recent work. Take a peek, get inspired, and reach out to learn more about what Custom Kitchens can do for your home!

For over 65 years, Custom Kitchens has designed one of a kind kitchens and baths for better living.

Our mission is to give every client the finest in design, installation, and service; to listen and respond; to focus on every detail; and to make the process a pleasure. It’s a promise from our family to yours.

Custom Kitchens, Inc. is a family-owned and operated company that has been serving Richmond homeowners for over 65 years. When you choose to let us improve your home, we consider it an honor, and we do not take the task lightly. 

“
In over 65 years of business, we have helped thousands of Richmond families make their homes more beautiful, functional, pleasant places to live.

We focus on every detail of your project, removing the stress and allowing you to take pleasure in the process of making your home a more beautiful place to live. While the technology, equipment, and design influences that our team use have changed over time, their fundamental process has not. We listen, we do it right, we do it on time, and that will never change. 

Don’t just take our word for it, let our clients tell you more.

Our team is here to serve you!

Richard Hendrick, CKD        President, Designer

Richard has spent his entire career in the family business. He started as a carpenter’s helper while in high school and college, learning the construction side of the business. He became President in 1986, and has stewarded the company in the time since, while ushering in the third generation. 

READ MORE

Kyle Hendrick                                 Vice President, Designer

Kyle was the first member of the third generation of the Hendrick family to join CKI. A Trinity and Radford grad, Kyle has learned the business from the ground up. He worked in the field and the front office before transitioning to design full-time in 2012, and has been taking on more managerial roles in recent years. 

READ MORE

Carter Hendrick                    Secretary, Designer

Another member of the Hendrick’s third generation,  Carter has been a designer for four years now. Prior to working in the CKI showroom, Carter ran his own business. His on-the-job education and entrepreneurial spirit fostered an attention to detail and laser focus that serves his clients well.

READ MORE

Curtis Hendrick                              Vice President of Operations, Designer

Curtis, a proud graduate of JMU, completes the third generation of the Hendrick family working at Custom Kitchens. After five years of project management in engineering, Curtis first returned to Custom Kitchens as the installation manager and now as a designer. 

READ MORE

Kimberly Carter                         Designer

After graduating from Virginia Tech with an interior design degree, Kimberly has been with Custom Kitchens for over 20 years. Her flexibility and can-do attitude have made her a rock for the design team, while her enthusiasm makes her a joy to have remodel your home.

READ MORE

Allison Stowers, CKD             Designer

Following in her mother’s footsteps, Allison has been in the kitchen & bath industry for over 20 years. She has been with Custom Kitchens since 2005 when she moved to the area, serving as multiple roles in the time since. Allison has a keen eye and gives her clients meticulous care. 

READ MORE

Julia Lipe                                                        Designer

Julia earned her BFA in Studio Art from Mary Wash, but after an interior design internship she was sucked into the residential design world! She’s worked in Florida, North Carolina, and of course, Virginia. She’s glad to be closer to home and bring clients’ dream spaces to life.

Andrew Blood          Designer

Originally from Ohio, Andrew earned his BFA in industrial design. He first started in the design world at a firm in West Virginia on the installation side. Since then, he has worked at several firms around Richmond, and loves bringing his client’s visions to life through his designs. 

Laura Lyles                                                  Project Manager & Designer

Laura keeps our designers on track! She handles managerial tasks for several of our designers.  Either in the office or in the field, Laura’s ever-present smile and eye for detail make her an easy favorite.

Jennifer Strader                           Client Care & Showroom Manager

Jennifer takes excellent care of our clients the moment they step in to Custom Kitchens. She serves as a guide to new clients and keeps the entire building running smoothly! 

Jan Romenak                            Product Specialist & Design Assistant

Jan is one of our newest additions to the team. She assists designers throughout the entire design process, as well as maintaining the showroom displays and products.

Kim Hatton                                 Accounts Manager

Kim keeps our books on track. She is the kind of person who actually enjoys tasks like job costing! Kim is  responsible for the smooth running of anything related to numbers- so basically, everything!  

Mark Christian                           Installation Coordinator

Mark came to CKI in 2023, and manages all of our clients’ service requirements and job scheduling. A VMI grad, Mark previously managed a small farm and oyster processing plant!

Robert Jensen                                  Shop Manager

A true master carpenter, Robert runs the workshop behind the CKI Showroom. He freely shares his knowledge and expertise with the team, and has made incredible pieces of cabinetry!

William Meredith                        Installation Specialist

William has been with Custom Kitchens since 1994. Our clients are continually impressed with his skill, experience, and attention to detail. He approaches every job as if it were taking place in his own home.

Matt Sackett                                Installation Specialist

Matt has been in the cabinet industry for over two decades, with fifteen years spent at Custom Kitchens. Matt loves bringing a project to life, from floor plans to installed cabinets. 

James (JT) Hall                           Installation Specialist

JT has been expertly installing cabinets and trim for over 30 years. Guaranteed if JT’s working in your home, you’ll hear him whistle intricate melodies all day long! 

Phil Holcombe                             Installation Specialist

Phil is a textbook jack-of-all-trades. An excellent problem solver, Phil is known for making it work while regaling everyone with many tales from his past careers. 

John Bonds                                              Warehouse Delivery Driver

For around 30 years, John has made sure that fixtures, appliances, and cabinets are delivered on time to our client’s homes. He has won numerous awards for his safe driving! 

Tyler Owens                           Warehouse Delivery Driver

Tyler helps guarantee the safe delivery of cabinets and appliances while also serving as a backup installer. His easy going attitude is perfect for busy job sites!

David Hendrick, CKD          Retired

Brothers with Richard, David worked the family business for forty-odd years. Serving as Vice President and a Designer, David is an integral part of the Custom Kitchens culture.

Doug Leake, CKD          Retired

Doug worked with Custom Kitchens for just under 40 years as an award winning designer. Occasionally, Doug will assist Allison with project management for her jobs although he is officially retired.

Bobby Hollins              Retired

Bobby has 50 years of carpentry experience, and was a master carpenter and installer during his tenure with CKI. Despite his retirement, you can still find Bobby helping out with a job or in the shop every now and then! 

Ronnie Harlow         Retired

Ronnie installed kitchens with us for several years, and had 30 years of experience in the construction industry. His sense of humor and knowledge made him essential to the team!

Featured Vendors & Trade Partners

We are proud to work with several premier builders and architects in the Richmond and Central Virginia region. We provide a great value to their clients by providing the best customized experience in kitchen and bath design possible.

Architects & Contractors

We are always looking to create new partnerships, so if you’d like to learn more about how we work with builders, contractors and architects - contact us. We know your clients will be happy with the experience and you’ll appreciate the amount of work we can take off your plate while managing your client through the design and installation process.

Please contact us directly at info@customkitchensinc.net.

Custom Kitchens provides luxury kitchen and bath renovations with over 65 years of experience!

  
We believe you deserve the finest in design, installation, and service for your kitchen and bath renovation.

Custom Kitchens, Inc. provides kitchen and bath renovations with a focus on the details. We listen to our clients’ needs and do everything we can to make the renovation process a pleasure. 

For over 65 years, it’s been a promise from our family to yours.

CLIENT HAPPINESS IS WHAT DRIVES US:
“
The installers were absolute craftsmen and took pride in everything they did, as if they were going to live here themselves. Every employee on the Custom Kitchens team was nice, friendly, very respectful of our home and dedicated to the project. We were truly amazed at the pride, craftsmanship, and commitment shown by the team every day, and to every detail.
— Kitchen Renovation, Near West End
READ MORE TESTIMONIALS

Our team is here to make your renovation dreams come true.

Our team of licensed contractors, certified kitchen and bath designers, and experienced craftsmen will help you create the perfect kitchen or bath that meets your needs and budget.

MEET THE TEAM

Our showroom is here to help you find the perfect style for your kitchen or bath renovation.

Our award-winning showroom is open to the public five days a week with a certified designer always on site to help you get inspired and start planning your dream renovation.

VISIT US
Our kitchen and bath renovations showcase all types of design styles, layouts, and functional needs.

Our promise is to create the kitchen or bath renovation of your dreams. Our portfolio features some our favorite projects we’ve had the pleasure of working on as well as some of our most recent work. Take a peek, get inspired, and reach out to learn more about what Custom Kitchens can do for your home!

Kyle Hendrick

An alumni of Trinity Episcopal School, Kyle received his BBA in Marketing from Radford University. After graduating, he started at Custom Kitchens in the front office, serving as a draftsperson and showroom manager before transitioning full time to design in 2012. His experience in all areas of business, along with completing full renovations on his own home, has provided Kyle with a unique perspective and understanding of the design and installation process. He is an active member of PRO Central VA and the NKBA. Kyle excels in attention to detail, space-saving ideas, and actively listening to his clients’ needs. 

Kyle resides in Richmond with his wife, two children, and golden retriever. He enjoys visiting Cape Charles and loves water skiing and sailing at Lake Anna.
